title: Structure Tensor
description: Fibre orientation, coherency and energy of a 2D image or 3D stack by structure-tensor analysis (the OrientationJ method).

analyse.title: Analyse orientation
analyse.description: Compute the Gaussian structure tensor of one image and return its orientation, coherency and energy maps, a colour map, the orientation distribution and a summary.

image.description: One greyscale or RGB image: a 2D image, or a 3D stack as a multi-page TIFF or 3D NIfTI

sigma.description: Gradient scale σ in pixels: the Gaussian derivative's standard deviation

rho.description: Window scale ρ in pixels: the standard deviation of the Gaussian that averages the tensor

minCoherency.description: Pixels below this coherency are left out of the orientation distribution

minEnergy.description: Pixels below this fraction of the largest energy are left out of the orientation distribution
